QUIC server test that boots a workspace, configures UDP I/O, and services the server loop.

# Purpose
This file contains a small [`main`](<#main>) program that starts a QUIC server for test use. It boots the runtime, creates a random number generator, initializes a clock, and reads command-line options for workspace page size, page count, and NUMA placement. It then creates an anonymous workspace, builds a server-side `fd_quic_t` instance, connects it to a UDP socket, and sets the network transmit and receive `fd_aio_t` paths, with optional PCAP capture support. After initialization, the program enters an infinite service loop that calls `fd_quic_service` and `fd_quic_udpsock_service` to process QUIC and UDP events.
